prose: A Guardian profile traces Huang's career from restaurant work to building Nvidia into a central AI supplier. It emphasizes technical fluency and communication as parts of his influence with customers and investors, while framing his reported resignation as a turning point. The retrospective is an account of his career and reputation, not independent resolution of the allegations surrounding his departure.
highlights: Career profile spans early work and Nvidia leadership
Technical communication is a central theme
Company grew from graphics into AI infrastructure
Profile does not settle surrounding allegations
